name: JAVA 佳沃 Suprema 7120 / 终结者
why_interesting: The exact mainland seller card is now anchored to current official and regional Suprema evidence; its selected domestic trim and checkout conditions remain unverified.

facts.frame_material: Current Colombian reference build: Toray T800 carbon frame, fork and seatpost; a current Uruguayan trim instead says 3K carbon
facts.frame_construction: Fully internally routed aero road frame with thru axles; exact lay-up, molding process and bottom-bracket standard are not published
facts.drivetrain: Current Colombian reference build: Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical 2x12, 52/36T crank and 11-34T cassette with R7170 hydraulic disc brakes
facts.complete_weight_basis: Current Colombian reference build claim; size, pedals, accessories and measurement method are not stated. A different size-52 Uruguayan trim claims approximately 8.4 kg
facts.wheels: Current Colombian reference build: 50 mm carbon wheels
facts.tires: Michelin Dynamic Sport 28-622 fitted on the Colombian reference build; this is not a published maximum
facts.stiffness_evidence: No exact-model numeric stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent frame-stiffness assessment was found across the 50-area sweep

missing: Maximum tire clearance and a complete current geometry table
Complete-weight size, pedal basis, accessories and measurement method
Meaningful exact-model stiffness evidence, exact selected mainland trim, domestic warranty route and final checkout price
source_note: The retained card identifies Suprema 7120 at CNY 9,999. Current regional sources establish labeled R7120 mechanical reference trims, but their 8.5 and approximately 8.4 kg claims, carbon wording and tire options differ; none is assigned to the seller-selected mainland option. Fitted 28C tires do not establish maximum clearance.
